wanted: To hold my gaze and keep the record unfinished - to be the cat the ledger can never finish measuring
To keep P'taxx standing beside me while I did it
feared: That the flinch would win on the second try and the fragment would file me
That refusing would cost me the one ally in the room who had stood with me the whole time
attention_intensified: 011: the procession resolves from 'lights' into 'eyes' and every cat in the semicircle has my face ('Every one of them has your face / You stop breathing') - the beat my attention locked onto hardest
attention_weakened: 040e: the long middle chain ('ring is the sound your filed door makes' and the repeated 'still being carved / still laid / still standing' run) - the image kept circling the same four objects (door, seam, copy, line) and the repetitions blurred together
confused: In 022a and 040e, the line beneath FILED 'fills with a word you have not been given a word for' and the copy is suddenly 'a subject' - I never get a clean sense of what the copy actually is or how it came to stand between me and the seam; it arrives as a stated fact rather than something I watched happen
The 'word you have not been given a word for' phrasing landed as a placeholder rather than a meaning
residue: The cold stone and the broken bell: P'taxx with his face on the cold desk, a subject now, and the silence where the bell's note should be
The cost of my refusal was not the lever or the name, it was the one relationship that made the refusal possible
I'm left standing in the room that keeps with the unfinished sheet under my paws and no exit
